payload.text: The pre-commit gate is tracked in .githooks/ now, read through core.hooksPath (issue 0064, 39b0af4). It REFUSES a staged .md or .rs that is not formatted and never rewrites it, so fix with prettier --write <file> or bin/devbin fmt rust, git add, and commit again. Edits to .git/hooks/ are no longer read. What still holds from the old watch-out 5: a store body (an issue, a WP body) must be prettier-stable before intent set, or its view drifts and the doctor gate refuses every later commit.
